title: PromptForgePromptEngineOutput
description: Canonical flat structured output for PromptForge Studio prompt enhancement. Quality checklist fields are intentionally excluded.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the enhanced prompt, based only on the user's provided intent.

needs_clarification.description: True only when refine mode needs more information before a strong rewrite can be produced.

questions.description: One to three specific clarification questions when needs_clarification is true; otherwise an empty array.

enhanced_prompt.description: The editable prompt the user can copy. Use an empty string only when clarification is required or the request is refused for safety.

role.description: The role/persona section to include in the enhanced prompt, or an empty string when clarification is required.

task.description: The concrete task the target model should perform, preserving the user's original intent.

context.description: Only the user-provided context and selected context snippets used by the enhanced prompt; never unselected context.

constraints.description: Explicit user constraints plus safe inferred structural constraints; use placeholders for unknown facts.

format.description: Requested output format for the target model, such as bullets, table, email, checklist, or concise paragraph.

tone.description: Best-fitting tone for the enhanced prompt. Choose one enum value; preserve any explicit user tone preference.

success_criteria.description: Observable criteria that define a useful target-model response to the enhanced prompt.

explanation.description: Brief plain-language reasons explaining what changed and why.

added.description: Prompt elements added to make the user's request clearer or more complete.

removed.description: Prompt elements removed or compressed; empty when nothing was removed.

changed.description: Prompt elements rewritten, reorganized, or made more specific.
